algorithm: { This is a modified version of the Efficient Global Optimization (EGO) algorithm, specifically designed for minimization problems with bounded variables. The main steps involve constructing an initial set of random candidate solutions within the given bounds, iteratively selecting the most informative solution through expected improvement, and updating the model to guide the next iteration of sampling. }

{The new algorithm is a modified version of the Simulated Annealing algorithm with a simple elitist strategy to improve convergence speed and robustness, which iteratively generates candidate solutions by perturbing the current best solution within the given bounds, evaluates their fitness, and updates the current best solution based on a probability function that balances exploration and exploitation.}
